title: What Floorbit is doing
empty: Nothing yet. Press Locate or plug the laptop in.
macTyped: Using the typed MAC {{mac}}, no agent needed
macReused: Same address as at the last seat: MAC {{mac}} again
monitoringOff: No monitoring source: on to the switches

monitoring.none: Monitoring source doesn't have it on a port yet
monitoring.uplink: Monitoring source only has it on an uplink: not the seat's port

stale: {{switch}} {{port}} is still the last seat's port: that table isn't fresh yet

snmpTodo.no_segment: {{ip}} is in no network segment: no SNMP lookup
snmpTodo.segment_off: Lookups are off for VLAN {{vlan}}: no SNMP lookup
snmpTodo.no_core: No core switch known for VLAN {{vlan}}: no SNMP lookup

snmpArp: Asking the core {{core}} for the MAC of {{ip}} (VLAN {{vlan}})

snmpMac.no: The core doesn't know the MAC yet

snmpAsk: SNMP through the agent, VLAN {{vlan}}: row's switches {{row}}, then block {{block}}, then {{others}} more
snmpError: The agent couldn't ask the switches: {{error}}
sshAsk: Last resort over SSH: show mac address-table on {{switches}}

sshSwitch.uplink: {{switch}} over SSH: only on uplink {{port}}, skipped

wait: Not found yet, asking again in {{seconds}} s (try {{attempt}})
